text: So yeah, everything's still really slow to update. So my mastermind, I need you to put a UI card on the screen that responds directly to what I'm about to tell you. And I'd prefer you do it sooner than later. I would like to know whether we should fix this whole assistant mastermind process to work better in parallel, because you're not going fast enough. Should we shut it all down and restart it? And how would you design this better?
